subject: Subject
chainNote: {n} certificate(s): the EST Issuing CA, this realm's Intermediate and the service Root — what /cacerts returns
noHostNames: No entry in this realm has a certificate host name registered, so no tls-server or tls-server-client certificate can be issued.
nothingEnrolled: Nothing has been enrolled over EST in this realm.
intro: Enrollment over Secure Transport (RFC 7030, with RFC 8951). A client authenticates with a password, a client secret or a TLS client certificate this realm issued, sends a base64 PKCS#10 request, and receives a certificate from this realm's EST Issuing CA. A person may enroll only for themselves, an application only for itself, and a holder of Admin Write for any entry in the realm.
turnedOff: EST is turned off in this realm.
profilesNote: A label in the path names the certificate profile (/.well-known/est/<profile>/…); the unlabelled path issues {profile}.
noCredential: EST has no credential of its own:
hIssue: Issue a certificate with a server-generated key
issueNote: The console's /serverkeygen: the private key is shown once on the next page and a sealed copy is kept on the entry.
hostNamesNote: A dNSName or iPAddress is issued only when it is registered on the entry.
noRequest: No EST request has been answered in this realm since the process started.
monitorIntro: What the EST server has done in this trust realm since {since}, across {n} process(es). Every request is counted, issued or refused; the durable record of each is the
noReset: There is no reset. The counters are per realm and start with the process.
